_contract: The shot list is a contract (§7A.9): fixed teams, fixed seed, fixed sim-frame timestamp and a fixed camera pose per shot. Same commit + same shot name => the same pixels. Camera poses are in SCENE coords (x along the pitch length, y up, z across the width = sim y). Changing a seed, a frame count or a pose invalidates every baseline captured before it, so treat edits here like an API break.
_teams: cze (red #D7141A) vs ger (white #FFFFFF) everywhere — two maximally distinct kits, and the keeper palette resolves clear of both.

shots.name: midfield_wide
shots.note: Open play, ball just left of the centre circle, both shapes on screen. Broadcast-height wide — the everyday readability shot.

shots.name: goalmouth_scramble
shots.note: Frame 986 of seed 8230: a German shot being struck on the edge of the six with a Czech defender sliding in and the keeper set — 9 bodies inside 14m of the ball. Camera behind the west goal, shooting through the net past the keeper.

shots.name: celebration_closeup
shots.note: Seed 22343 scores at frame 1706 (Goretzka, 1'). 54 frames later he is mid-celebrate at (-46.1, 6.2) under falling confetti — a real goal celebration, not a posed close-up.

shots.name: stadium_establishing
shots.note: The whole bowl from a high corner at night: roof line, three tiers, all four floodlight banks. The venue-scale and floodlight-bloom shot.

shots.name: pitch_stripes_low_sun
shots.note: Knee-height camera raking the full length of the pitch into a low sunset key — the mowing stripes, the goalmouth wear and the grass grain all read at a glancing angle here and nowhere else.

shots.name: specular_bloom_check
shots.note: A player at 6m, backlit by the low sunset key, standing against the pool of sun-raked grass behind him. This is the §7A.6 grey-halo regression test: the bloom must rim the silhouette, not paint a desaturated halo around it.

shots.name: tele_midfield
shots.note: CAMERA. The tele cam doing its everyday job, shot from wherever the director actually put it. Same seed/frame as midfield_wide, so the two PNGs are a direct before/after on the broadcast rig.

shots.name: tele_endzone
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 8230 frame 986: a shot being struck on the edge of the six. The tele cam's end-zone behaviour — it rises and swings its aim onto the goalmouth so net, keeper and shooter share the frame.

shots.name: tele_nearside
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 22343 frame 484: the ball on the +y touchline, metres from the lens. The tele cam's near/far asymmetry — the rig has to rise and pull back hard here or the play is under the camera.

shots.name: tele_farside
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 12648430 frame 944: the same thing on the far touchline, 70m out, where the rig must NOT back off the same way.

shots.name: penalty_cam
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 12648430 penalty (frames 1544-2001): behind the taker, low, the goal filling the frame, creeping in.

shots.name: setpiece_kickoff
shots.note: CAMERA. Phase 'kickoff' (frames 0-84): high, wide, centred — the whole pitch and both shapes.

shots.name: setpiece_throwin
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 4242 throw-in (frames 856-953): touchline, medium, always shot from the broadcast side so the pitch never flips left-to-right on a dead ball.

shots.name: setpiece_corner
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 4242 corner (frames 1404-1570): behind the corner flag, elevated, looking across the six-yard box.

shots.name: setpiece_freekick
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 1337 free kick (frames 2296-2392): behind the taker, slightly elevated, down the line of the shot with the goal in frame.

shots.name: setpiece_goalkick
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 12648430 goal kick (frames 2001-2098): behind the keeper, wide, the length of the pitch ahead of him.

shots.name: goal_slowmo
shots.note: CAMERA. Seed 22343 scores at frame 1706. +1.2s into the goal package: the ball crossing the line at 0.38x from behind the net.

shots.name: goal_celebration
shots.note: CAMERA. +3.6s: the celebration rig tracking cam.subject, low TV angle, mid push-in, under falling confetti.

shots.name: goal_crowd
shots.note: CAMERA. +5.7s: the 1.2s crowd cutaway, pitch-side and looking up into the near rake behind the scoring end.

shots.name: goal_replay_crane
shots.note: CAMERA. +7.2s: replay angle 1, the high crane behind the goal drifting across it.

shots.name: goal_replay_dolly
shots.note: CAMERA. +9.2s: replay angle 2, the low sideline dolly riding the ball.

shots.name: goal_replay_ballcam
shots.note: CAMERA. +11.2s: replay angle 3, the chase rig a few metres off the ball's own trajectory.

shots.name: beauty_crane
shots.note: CAMERA. The 'beauty' mode used behind the half-time and full-time cards: a slow stadium crane orbiting the bowl, caught 6s into its arc.

shots.name: present_walkout_tunnel
shots.note: CUTSCENE. Pre-match walkout, 4.0s in: the two files leaving the tunnel mouth on the far touchline, shot low from the scene's own camera track. `frames` counts the SCENE clock — a walkout holds the sim, so no football happens during it.

shots.name: present_walkout_lineup
shots.note: CUTSCENE. Walkout at 14.5s: both teams are on their marks square to the near touchline, on three different idles at three different phases, and the pitch-level dolly is mid-pass along the line. The T-pose / foot-slide / everyone-in-lockstep regression shot.

shots.name: present_walkout_break
shots.note: CUTSCENE. Walkout at 20.5s: the line has broken and the teams are jogging out to the sim's own kickoff marks under the rising crane. Checks the run cycles and the hand-off framing.

shots.name: present_goal_mob
shots.note: CUTSCENE. Seed 22343 scores at frame 1706; +4.8s (2.5s of SCENE time — the goal package's own slow-mo owns the first 2.3s and the scene does not tick under a replay) the scorer is most of the way to the corner flag with three team-mates closing, shot through the camera director's celebration rig, which tracks cam.subject — kept on the scorer's live position by the scene.

shots.name: present_goal_losers
shots.note: CUTSCENE. Same goal, +3.9s, pinned on the beaten half: the keeper's dejection and the losing side trudging back toward their own half. The celebration is 90m away off frame.

shots.name: present_fulltime
shots.note: CUTSCENE. Seed 22343 at frame 2500 (1-0, back in open play after the goal package), full-time forced and played 4.2s: the winners applauding the near stand, the losers already trudging off toward the tunnel. Pinned broadcast-height pose — the camera director puts its beauty crane on the real card, 120m out, where none of this would read.

shots.name: present_halftime
shots.note: CUTSCENE. The interval walk-off 6s in: nobody performs, the two sides just head for the tunnel mouth on the far touchline, the side that is behind noticeably heavier than the side in front.
